notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: 10 of the best new Steam games this week
notes.notes:
Welcome back to Unknown Pleasures, our weekly digest of the best new games released on Steam over the past seven days, but which most probably flew under your radar.

This time: Pong with 500 balls, XCOM meets SUPERHOT, house-trashing wizards, the not quite so fantastical Mr Fox and feline Zelda.
(more…)

notes.title: Out today!
notes.notes:
Hey!

Peregrin will be launching today in about 7 hours. We always encounter a few minutes of weirdness from hitting the launch button and it actually going live, but it should be going out at 5pm BST!

We look forward to you experiencing Abi's journey across The Divide later on today!

notes.title: Combat Gameplay and Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hello!

We're pleased to show off a couple of things today. The first look at combat in the game, and to announce the release date!

In this video, David from Green Man Gaming sits down with the combat and shows off some simple battles - and then jumps to something to a little more advanced later in the game!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fVG949mUPzM

We're also pleased to announce the release date for [b]Peregrin[/b]. The game will be launching next week on [b]Tuesday 8th August 2017[/b]!

In addition, there will be trading cards, achievements and localisation in the form of interface and subtitles for 13 languages, including Korean, Japanese and Arabic! 

Look forward to seeing you all on Tuesday 8th August to journey across The Divide.
